crossRefs.note: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned…
An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen…

translations.web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
translations.bsb: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but an abundant harvest comes through the strength of the ox.
translations.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
translations.asv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.
